# discord_emoji (Resource)

Manages a custom server emoji. Requires the Create Expressions permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_emoji" "party" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  name      = "party_parrot"
  image     = "data:image/gif;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/party_parrot.gif")}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Image as a data URI (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, at most 256 KiB), e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("emoji.png")}"`. Changing it uploads a new emoji.
- `name` (String) Emoji name (2-32 letters, digits or underscores).
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `roles` (Set of String) Role IDs allowed to use the emoji. Omit to allow everyone.

### Read-Only

- `animated` (Boolean) Whether the emoji is animated.
- `id` (String) Emoji ID.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the emoji is managed by an integration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_emoji.party <server_id>/<emoji_id>
```
